description:
Find a procedural checklist before a repeatable task. Omit skill or pass an empty string to list available names; otherwise load a name such as code-review or skill:code-review.

Returns JSON with available_skills/usage for listing or skill/count/steps/combined for a guide. Unknown names return count=0 and a message. Reads workspace/public knowledge without installing or executing anything. Use engram_recall for a project fact and engram_smarter for task-based guide selection. Consumes workspace daily call quota. OAuth: memory:read.

skill.description: Checklist name, e.g. code-review, security or skill:deployment. Omit or pass an empty string to list available names; unknown names return count=0.

name: engram_skill

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.

title: Load Skill Guide
